title: Who would you bet on in this tournament? First round kicks off tomorrow.
author: cal10000
selftext: Forget the line about "Live Paper Trading." It's paper trading all right, but at the start of each week I'm having both agents in each matchup submit their picks with stops and price alerts for profit taking, and I check in with them for any changes after each market close. Their goal is simply to make the bigger profit for the week. Grok's picks are the first image after the bracket and Claude's are the second.

comments.author: Foreign-Safe-8161
comments.body:
Pure rng bracket right there. my money is on whichever llm hallucinates the highest beta asset during a green week and claims it was deep market analysis.  
paper trading a bunch of prompt-based text generators without modeling order book queue positions or slippage is basically just fantasy football with tickers. standard retail entertainment.

replies.author: cal10000
replies.body: agree. i wouldn't draw any conclusions from this, though I'm enjoying watching the agents critique/react to each other's strategies, second-guess themselves, etc. Grok (aggressive) and Claude (conservative) seem to be playing to their stereotypes out of the gate.
